name: Global Fact-Check Bot (GFC)
tagline: A pioneering AI platform that empowers fact-checkers and citizens worldwide to verify information accuracy across 50+ languages, powered by 38 trusted organizations
project_type: AI fact-checking chatbot / civic information tool
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
countries_deployed: 43 countries across Europe, Americas, Africa, MENA, Asia
dependency_risks: Dependence on IFCN and EFCSN institutional support

news_articles.headline: The Global Fact-Check Chatbot (GFC) has been officially constituted

academic_citations.title: Eco-friendly policies and financial performance: Was the financial crisis a game changer for large US companies?
Contextualizing Mangrove Forest Deforestation in Southeast Asia Using Environmental and Socio-Economic Data Products
Role of artificial intelligence in moderating the innovative financial process of the banking sector: a research based on structural equation modeling

causation_strength: Not yet established - project in early implementation phase
outcome_methodology: Pilot testing across five Eastern European fact-checking organizations; formal evaluation framework under development
published_performance_metrics: 78% accuracy rate in pilot testing across five Eastern European fact-checking organizations
documented_limitations: Currently only 10 languages in Phase 1 (50+ planned)
Membership closed to founding 38 organizations until 2026 expansion
Consolidates existing fact-checks — cannot generate new original fact-checks
failure_modes: AI hallucination presenting inaccurate fact-check results
Coverage gaps for languages and regions with fewer fact-checkers
Potential misuse for automated political censorship claims
governance_model: Consortium governance by 38 founding member organizations; governed exclusively by professional fact-checkers
curation_criteria: Sources information exclusively from verified IFCN and EFCSN network members
contributor_governance: Elected working groups; new organizational members expected to be admitted from 2026
disparity_tracking: Planned expansion to 50+ languages aims to address geographic and linguistic disparities in fact-checking coverage
community_ownership: Collectively owned by the 38 founding member organizations
political_bias_allegations: None documented; governance structure designed to mitigate bias through multi-organizational oversight
ai_involvement: Core: planner-evaluator LLM architecture that maps out action plans and verifies evidence before generating responses
